name: Cedar Hills Campground
note: Adults-only, clothing-optional campground. Mostly seasonal: 12 of its ~59 RV sites are sold by the night online (2027 ParkWith map). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site cedarhillscamp.com (read 2026-10-21): RV sites with hookups, 50 tent sites and park models, open Apr 15-Oct 15, books via ParkWith; ParkWith engine sold a single weeknight (Tue Jun 15 2027) and a single Friday (Jun 18) on 12 nightly RV sites 24-40 ft (30A + water) for a 23-ft Class C, no membership/application in its rules; Google Maps 4.4 from 73 reviews with phone, pin within ~0.4 km -> real transient RV campground with a seasonal majority; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Esri satellite 2026-10-21 at 43.2108,-89.7478 (1.2 km and 400 m frames, rendered): RV pads strung along a lane in a wooded hillside valley east of WI-78; no lake, river or stream visible within ~600 m (nearest is a marshy strip west across WI-78 and the rail line, not reachable from the sites); operator page only claims 'Wisconsin River access nearby' -> not waterfront
fees_source: https://parkwith.us/camps/cedar-hills-campground checkout read 2026-10-21: RV Site 54B (30A, water, 24 ft), Tue Jun 15-16 2027, 2 adults, 23-ft Class C/travel trailer: $50.00 x 1 night; plus a $4.89 ParkWith service/processing fee per booking (not a grounds fee). All 12 nightly RV sites quote $50; same on Fri Jun 18 and Tue Aug 10 2027.
flags: Adults-only AND clothing-optional (nudist) campground; no membership, application or day fee found in ParkWith's rules or checkout, but AWH may not want a clothing-optional park

Mostly seasonal: only 12 of ~59 RV sites on ParkWith's map are offered by the night (~20%, passes the 1-in-10 test); some nightly sites are named for seasonal occupants (e.g. 'Site 21-For Sale Trailer for Sale by owner', 'Site 53-Open Seasonal')
No standing minimum for RV sites (single nights sold weeknight and Friday); park models carry a 2-night minimum
Season Apr 15 - Oct 15 (operator home page); RV sites 30A electric + water per engine (home page says full hookups)
why: Passes every other gate (ParkWith sells one night $50 on 12 nightly RV sites, read 2026-10-21; Google 4.4/73), but the park is adults-only and clothing-optional; held for AWH rather than added
